Resolves #18895

The e2e engine tier runs as two Playwright shards on two runners, serial within each, and each under the five-minute step budget. PR #18891's red was the tier outgrowing that budget: `98 passed (5.1m)`, then the step timed out. A dispatch stays one shard, so a probe's tally keeps its whole denominator.

Evidence: L2 — this pull request's own tier run (`classify-test-scope.yml` selects the tier when `test-e2e.yml` changes), plus a dispatch on this branch. Locally, the two shard listings partition the selection. Residual: none.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline jobs ran. Change class: `restoration` (`ci`).

## AC Evidence

| AC | |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | run [35357270976](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/35357270976): `e2e-engine (1/2)` ran 55 tests in a 2 m 25 s test step, and `e2e-engine (2/2)` ran 50 in 2 m 27 s. Unsharded, `--list` at this head selects 105 tests in 30 files |
| AC-2 | dispatch [35357278922](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/35357278922) on this branch ran as the single job `e2e-engine (1/1)`, green |
| AC-3 | the failure artifact is `test-results-e2e-engine-<run_id>-shard-<N>` |
| AC-4 | the header's Time paragraph and the run step's comment put the budget per shard, and say that a shard nearing it gets a sibling |

## Deltas from ticket

- **No aggregator job.** No rule on `dev` requires the `e2e-engine` context, so the shards report under their own names.

## Test Evidence

- **Shard 1's one red is not this diff.** `CellEditingLockedBodies` › "a draft survives its column moving to the end body and back…" is a `test.fail()` arm for #18885. Its defect is race-dependent, and in that run it did not reproduce ("Expected to fail, but passed"). #18897 turns the arm into a plain test. The rerun of the shard passed, so both shards are green at this head.
- `--list` at `dev@5f4caec813`: unsharded 102 tests in 29 files. `--shard=1/2` gives 56 tests in 13 files, and `--shard=2/2` gives 46 in 16.
- Estimated from #18891's per-file times, the shards take about 111 s and 157 s of test time, before server start.
- The workflow parses as intended (the matrix, the `SHARD` env, the shard-1 coverage condition, the artifact name). `check-guard-ci-parity` and `check-whitespace` exit 0.

## Post-Merge Validation

- [ ] The next push to `dev` runs both shards green.

*   **Inputs Read Before Patch:** #18895. `dev`'s `.github/workflows/test-e2e.yml`: the step's `timeout-minutes: 5` with the comment making it the gate's budget, the dispatch budget beside it, the coverage summary and the artifact upload. *   **Expected Solution Shape:** a matrix of Playwright shards on separate runners. Each stays `--workers=1` under the same per-step budget.
